confidence_notes: I couldn't find an RBA observation for November 2026. The FX figure is the latest one my search returned: 20 March 2026, 0.7088 USD per AUD, taken from the RBA exchange-rates page. It is about 8 months old, so the server should replace it with the latest RBA rate. Food and drink prices are based on Numbeo-style averages for Tokyo from a June 2026 snapshot reported by Expatica, checked against Expatarrivals, Citycost and Whereandwhen: inexpensive meal about ¥1,200, cappuccino about ¥534, 0.5 L draft beer about ¥550–600. I converted yen to USD at an assumed rate of about ¥150 per USD from general knowledge, not a searched rate, which adds some uncertainty. The beer anchor uses the 0.5 L restaurant draft price. The mid-range meal for two (about ¥6,500), cocktail (about ¥1,000) and wine glass (about ¥700) are estimates based on Tokyo's usual price ratios to beer and the inexpensive meal, not direct search results. Accommodation figures are general-knowledge estimates for July, a busy tourist season, and weren't checked against any listings. Basic hotels in Tokyo are compact business hotels, and prices vary a lot by district and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mainly based on Tokyo price data. Accommodation was benchmarked against what I know of hotels in Osaka and Seoul, adjusted upward for Tokyo's higher demand and the strong tourism season in 2025–2026.
